content_html: Watched #GPSK…..a good movie with best efforts from Krish n Bala Krishna…..n yes no one could have suited the role better than balaya babu. Will not say its a must watch but definetly a good watch, dont go with all the hype about Telugu jathi gawravam etc…..its just a normal periodic movie with excellent dialoges n perfect direction and who else we have other than balaya babu to mouth those terrific dialoges!!! Considering the limitations budget time and balaya’s age n size its a Fantastic movie
